title: Courage & Strength
intro: Somewhere around this age a child works out that being brave and being unafraid are not the same thing, and it can knock them sideways. This month we tell them the truth — courage is doing the right thing while your heart is still going fast, and they are not expected to do any of it on their own.

keyScriptures.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
Do not fear, for I am with you; I will strengthen you and help you.

weeks.title: Brave Is Not Unafraid
weeks.declaration: Being brave does not mean you stop feeling scared. It means you do the right thing while you are still scared, and that counts double.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, take the shame out of our child's fear. Let them know that being afraid is not failing. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are Not Alone in It
weeks.declaration: You are never sent anywhere on your own. God goes with you into the hard room, the new place, the difficult conversation.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, go with our child where we cannot follow. Be nearer to them in the hard moments than we could be. Amen.

weeks.title: Strength for Today
weeks.declaration: You do not need enough strength for the whole year. You need enough for today, and that is what you are given.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, give our child what today needs and no more, so they learn to come back tomorrow. Amen.

weeks.title: Standing Up
weeks.declaration: Some of the bravest things are quiet: telling the truth, saying no, sitting with the person nobody is sitting with.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, make our child brave in small ordinary ways. Let them be the one who does the right thing first. Amen.

days.title: Brave and Scared at Once
days.declaration: Being brave does not mean you are not scared. It means you do the right thing anyway, and that counts double.

scripture.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid.

days.title: He Goes With You
days.declaration: You are not sent anywhere alone. God goes with you into every room you are nervous about.

scripture.text: The Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you.

days.title: Strength for Today
days.declaration: You do not need enough strength for the whole year. You only need enough for today.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Strong Where You Are Weak
days.declaration: You do not have to be strong all by yourself. God is strongest in the places where you are not.

scripture.text: My power is made perfect in weakness.

days.title: Try Again
days.declaration: Being brave often just means having another go. People who keep trying end up further than people who were never scared.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: Telling the Truth Is Brave
days.declaration: Owning up is one of the bravest things anyone does. It takes more courage than hiding.

scripture.text: You desired faithfulness even in the womb.

days.title: Saying No
days.declaration: Saying no when everyone else is saying yes takes real strength. You are allowed to be the one who stops.

scripture.text: Daniel resolved not to defile himself.

days.title: Going First
days.declaration: Someone has to be first to be kind in a room. It might as well be you, and it usually changes everything.

scripture.text: Do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you.

days.title: Fear Does Not Get the Last Word
days.declaration: You are allowed to feel afraid. You are not required to obey it.

scripture.text: God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love and self-discipline.

days.title: Asking for Help Is Brave
days.declaration: Asking for help is not giving up. It is one of the strongest things a person can do.

scripture.text: Two are better than one.

days.title: New Places
days.declaration: New things feel big before they feel normal. Almost everything you are good at started as something new.

scripture.text: See, I am doing a new thing!

days.title: Wrong in Front of People
days.declaration: Getting it wrong in front of people is survivable. It is not the end of you, and tomorrow still comes.

scripture.text: Though I have fallen, I will rise.

days.title: Small Brave Things
days.declaration: Most courage is small and quiet: putting your hand up, going in, starting the conversation.

scripture.text: Do not despise these small beginnings.

days.title: Standing With Someone
days.declaration: Being brave for someone else is often easier than being brave for yourself. Start there if you need to.

scripture.text: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves.

days.title: You Have Been Brave Before
days.declaration: You have already done things that frightened you. Look back at them when today looks big.

scripture.text: The Lord who rescued me from the lion will rescue me.

days.title: Strength Is Quiet
days.declaration: Strong people do not need everyone to know. Real strength does not shout about itself.

scripture.text: In quietness and trust is your strength.

days.title: Nervous Is Normal
days.declaration: Feeling nervous before something that matters is not a warning. It is just your body noticing it matters.

scripture.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

days.title: Keep Going
days.declaration: Some days brave just means carrying on. That is enough, and it counts.

scripture.text: Let us not become weary in doing good.

days.title: Not the Biggest in the Room
days.declaration: You do not have to be the biggest or the loudest to be strong. David was neither.

scripture.text: The Lord does not look at the things people look at.

days.title: When You Are Left Out
days.declaration: Being left out hurts and it is not a sign that something is wrong with you. It is a sign that today was hard.

scripture.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

days.title: Doing the Right Thing Alone
days.declaration: Sometimes nobody joins in. Doing the right thing on your own is still worth it.

scripture.text: Act justly, love mercy, walk humbly with your God.

days.title: Courage to Say Sorry
days.declaration: Apologising properly takes more nerve than arguing. It is a strength worth practising early.

scripture.text: Confess your sins to each other.

days.title: The Strength to Wait
days.declaration: Waiting is hard and it is a kind of strength. Not everything worth having arrives quickly.

scripture.text: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.

days.title: Not Giving Up on Yourself
days.declaration: On the days you disappoint yourself, do not walk away from yourself. Start again tomorrow.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Kind and Brave
days.declaration: The bravest people are usually the kindest. It takes strength to stay gentle when you could be sharp.

scripture.text: Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

days.title: Facing the Hard Subject
days.declaration: The subject you dread is not stronger than you. Go at it a little at a time.

scripture.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

days.title: You Are Held While You Try
days.declaration: You are held while you are trying, not only when you succeed. That is why you can risk it.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Brave With Your Words
days.declaration: Speaking up when something is unfair is brave. So is staying quiet when speaking would only hurt.

scripture.text: How good is a timely word!

days.title: You Are Not Too Small
days.declaration: You are not too young or too small to do something that matters. God has never been fussy about that.

scripture.text: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young.

days.title: Strength That Is Given
days.declaration: You are not asked to make your own strength. It is given to you, daily, for exactly what today holds.

scripture.text: The Lord is my strength and my shield.

days.title: Take It Into Tomorrow
days.declaration: Everything you have been brave about this month has made you stronger for the next thing.

scripture.text: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
